_comment: GLM's `moe` DSL weight name maps to `mlp` on disk (HF safetensors store the MoE block under `model.layers.{l}.mlp`), and the shared expert lives under `mlp.shared_experts` — PLURAL, unlike Qwen's `mlp.shared_expert` — so the DSL's singular name renames per-leaf. GLM checkpoints ship BF16 RMSNorm gains.
